'''Rod Latham Pacific Blue Twelve''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst9.htm Pacific Blue Twelve], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319184431/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst9.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Event:''' [[January 1999 Birmingham tournament]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Played:''' Jan. 1999

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 31st January 1999, 3 wins and 0 losses from 3 games (differential +64).<ref name="trandosite" />
